---
title: "Ask a Question"
subtitle: "Stuck on a recitation question, a formula or a homework step? Post it here."
---

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
## How it works

- **Post your question** with the **+** button. You can post anonymously, and no account is needed.
- **Say where it comes from**, e.g. *"Recitation 2, Q20: how do I find Q1?"*. Questions with a clear reference get faster answers.
- **You can attach one clear photo** of your working (no PDFs or long files).
- **Check first** whether someone has already asked the same thing. If so, add a ❤️ instead of posting again.
- **Answers** appear as comments under each question, usually within a day or two.
- Everything here is **public** to everyone with the site link. Don't write your name, student number or any personal information.
:::
